learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will discover naming words for everything around us, including special names and fun group names!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A noun is a naming word! Every person, place, animal, and thing has a name. Boy, dog, school, and pencil are all nouns.
Common nouns are general names like city or boy. Proper nouns are special, VIP names like Delhi or Rahul! Proper nouns always wear a big hat and start with a Capital letter.
Sometimes nouns love to hang out in groups! A Collective Noun is a special name for a group. Like a bunch of grapes, or a flock of birds.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Noun Detective Hunt!
fun_activity.instructions: Walk around your house with a notebook. Write down 5 Common Nouns you see (like table, TV) and 5 Proper Nouns (like the brand of the TV, or your pet's name)!

quick_recap: ⭐ Nouns are naming words for people, places, animals, and things.
⭐ Proper nouns are special names and always start with a capital letter.
⭐ Collective nouns are names for groups of things.
